start.title: 아담의 아들들
start.text:
당신은 아담과 하와의 맏아들로 눈을 뜹니다.
둘째 아들 아벨이 당신 뒤에 태어납니다.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Live as the firstborn son of Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:1-2 — Eve gave birth to Cain, and then to his brother Abel.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Be born before Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Adam and Eve came first; Cain was their son.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Grow up as an only child
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain had a brother, Abel.

fields.title: 당신의 일
fields.text:
세월이 흐릅니다. 각 형제는 자신의 일을 찾습니다.
당신의 일은 무엇입니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Work the ground as a tiller of the soil
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Keep flocks of sheep like Abel
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Abel kept flocks; Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Refuse to work at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain worked the ground.

abel_pasture.title: 당신 형제의 일
abel_pasture.text:
당신은 들판 건너편에 있는 아벨을 봅니다.
그는 무엇을 하고 있습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] See Abel keeping flocks of sheep
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:2 — Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] See Abel tilling the ground beside you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Abel kept flocks, not that he tilled the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] See Abel fishing at the river
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis does not describe Abel fishing.

offerings.title: 제단 앞에서
offerings.text:
주님께 제물을 바칠 때가 옵니다.
무엇을 가져오시겠습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Bring some of the fruits of the soil as an offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Bring a firstborn lamb from your flock
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Abel brought a lamb; Cain brought fruits of the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Bring nothing at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain did bring an offering, though not the best.

accepted.title: 주님의 관심
accepted.text:
주님께서 두 제물을 보시는 동안 당신은 기다립니다.
무슨 일이 일어납니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The Lord looks with favor on Abel and his offering, but not on yours
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:4-5 — The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but on Cain and his offering He did not look with favor.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The Lord favors both offerings equally
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the Lord favored Abel's offering, not both.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] The Lord accepts your offering and rejects Abel's
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the opposite — the Lord favored Abel's offering.

anger.title: 당신의 얼굴이 어두워지다
anger.text:
제사가 끝났습니다. 당신 안에서 무언가가 솟아오릅니다.
어떻게 반응하시겠습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Become very angry, your face downcast
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:5 — Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Rejoice with Abel over his accepted offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain became angry, not that he rejoiced.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Bring a better offering the very next day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis does not describe Cain bringing a second offering.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 'Sin is crouching at your door — but you must rule over it'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:6-7 — The Lord warned Cain that sin was crouching at his door and he must rule over it.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] 'Bring a lamb instead of grain'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis does not record the Lord telling Cain to bring a lamb.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Nothing — the Lord is silent
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says the Lord did speak to Cain about sin at the door.

invitation.title: 당신이 형제에게 말하다
invitation.text:
아벨이 믿음직스럽게 가까이 걸어옵니다.
무엇이라고 말합니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Say to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:8 — Cain said to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field.'

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Invite Abel to worship at the altar together
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain led Abel out to the field, not to the altar.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Send Abel away and never speak to him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain called Abel to the field, not that he sent him away.

field.title: 들판에서
field.text:
너와 아벨은 넓은 들판에 단둘이 있습니다.
어떻게 하시겠습니까?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Attack Abel your brother and kill him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:8 — Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Argue with Abel and then forgive him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain killed Abel; he did not forgive him.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Walk home without touching him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain killed Abel in the field.

confrontation.title: “네 아우가 어디 있느냐?”
confrontation.text:
주님의 음성이 너를 찾습니다.
“네 아우 아벨이 어디 있느냐?”

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Answer: 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'I don't know. Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Confess plainly: 'I have killed him'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain denied knowing; he did not confess plainly.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Stay silent before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Genesis says Cain answered the Lord; he did not stay silent.

wanderer.title: 방황하는 자
wanderer.text:
주님께서 너를 보호하시기 위해 표를 주십니다.
너는 에덴 동쪽 놋 땅으로 방황하러 나갑니다.
